japanese: お弁当箱を見てたら、お腹すいてきた。
japanese_furigana: お[弁当箱|べんとうばこ]を[見|み]てたら、お[腹|なか]すいてきた。
english: Looking at lunchboxes has made me hungry.
explanation: 見てたら is the casual form of 見ていたら. The hunger begins to develop while the speaker is looking.

grammar_points.note: The conditional/temporal 〜たら appears after the contracted ongoing form.
見てたら contracts 見ていたら; 〜ている supplies the ongoing aspect.
The change develops toward the speaker's present state.
